system.description:
Action 1 AP

You quiet your own thoughts and allow inherited fragments of memory to surface. The next Recall Knowledge check you attempt before the end of your next turn gains advantage.

Ancestral Communion does not allow you to attempt a check that would otherwise be impossible, nor does it grant knowledge that could never have been possessed by the Myrathi or their ancestors.

Use: spends 1 AP in combat and the ability's Focus use (restored by Refocus), and puts the advantage on your next Recall Knowledge check automatically.
